name: buy-first secondhand clothing resale prep

product.purpose: Prepare sourced-category buy ceilings, listing drafts from owner-provided item facts and original photos, and sold-item shipping checklists for owner review.
product.inventory_model: BUY-FIRST: the owner purchases and physically possesses each item before any listing; owner takes original photos.
product.data_access: Local CSV and local photo paths only. No Depop login, API, browsing, scraping, bot, posting, purchase, or label purchase.
product.listing_handoff: Vendor-neutral CSV; no named crosslisting vendor is claimed as Depop-approved because Depop does not publish a named approved-vendor list.
product.pricing_assumption: Illustrative USD ceilings target 50% contribution margin after US payment processing, seller-paid postage, and packaging; owner verifies current fees and comparable sold prices before purchase.
limitations: Depop trend coverage is directional, not proof of category sell-through or revenue.
Owner must confirm all listing facts and original-photo ownership; the script cannot infer authenticity or verify photo provenance.
A Depop-authorized API-connected crosslisting vendor and its import schema must be confirmed by the owner before using the CSV with any external service.
Owner purchases inventory, chooses final prices, manually approves and publishes listings, buys labels, packs, and ships.

your_steps.title: Buy, photograph, review, list, pack, and ship each item
your_steps.when: For each sourcing batch, before listing, and whenever an item sells
your_steps.detail: The owner uses the buy ceilings to choose and purchase inspected used inventory, takes original photos after receiving it, reviews the local draft, manually lists through Depop or a vendor Depop has confirmed as API-authorized, and personally packs and ships any sold order. Before selling, check whether the business meets Georgia's dealer definition and, if so, register for Sales & Use Tax through GTC; registration is free. DOR says online registration is available through GTC and electronic filing is free. Use Georgia Form ST-5 only for qualifying tax-exempt wholesale purchases for resale, not personal-use purchases. No drop-shipped or supplier-catalogue stock is used. Follow OWNER-STEPS.md click by click.

launch_gates: Do not list catalog drop-shipped goods, stock/supplier photos, or items not physically owned and available to ship.
Sell only authentic, legally owned, Depop-permitted used clothing; do not list prohibited items or counterfeit goods.
Use only the owner's original item photos and review all AI/template text for accuracy; no unsupported brand, era, material, or condition claims.
Do not use bots, scraping, browser automation, or Depop API access. Only a vendor the owner confirms is Depop-authorized for API crosslisting may be used outside this local tool.
Remove a cross-listed item promptly if it sells elsewhere and personally resolve any double sale.
No buying, account creation, publishing, spending, label purchase, or external write is performed by the venture scripts.
